headline: Exploring Newtown, Connecticut This Fall
subhead: Historic landmarks, scenic trails, and convenient highway access in Fairfield County.
caption: October brings vibrant fall foliage to Newtown, Connecticut. From the iconic Main Street flagpole and historic Edmond Town Hall to the open walking paths across Fairfield Hills, the town offers a distinct mix of historic character and preserved open space. Outdoor recreation spans Lake Zoar, Treadwell Park, and miles of hiking trails at Holcombe Hill Preserve and Paugussett State Forest. Main Street and Sandy Hook village feature local dining and shops, while Interstate 84 and Route 25 provide direct connections across Greater Danbury and Fairfield County. If you are exploring the area and considering a move to Newtown, reach out today to discuss current market opportunities.
